lines.land: Point at a table, or the floor, and pinch. The set lands there.
lines.mine: That one was mine. Now pinch Talk, on the panel to the left of the set, and tell me yours.
lines.say: Pinch Talk, on the panel to the left of the set, and tell me the shot.
lines.block: Move anything by hand, or pinch Talk and tell me what to change. When you like the frame, pinch Snap frame.
lines.frame: That is your first frame. Pinch Step inside to stand in it.
lines.inside: You are inside the set. Point at the floor and pinch, and you walk to the yellow ring. Turn left and turn right are on the panel.
lines.done: That is the walkthrough. The set is yours.
lines.full: The board is full. Pinch Save the board to keep its picture, then Next board for another.
lines.back: Welcome back. Your set is where you left it.
lines.voice: I will read you what I build, in this voice.
lines.nomic: I cannot hear you in here, so here is another shot to try.
